definitions.explanation: Showing a tendency to resist, push back, or oppose authority, ideas, or other people. Describes attitudes or behavior that actively reject what is being imposed.

examples.japanese: {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{思春期|ししゅんき}→思春期：12667_shishunki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}に⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Adolescent children tend to become resistant toward their parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}した→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: The employees showed a resistant reaction to the new rules.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ (repulsion; opposition) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Describes a person or group that pushes back against authority, rules, or pressure. Common in discussions of interpersonal dynamics, workplace relations, and developmental psychology.

The related verb ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}する→反発する：26991_hanpatsusuru⟧ means to resist or push back, and the noun ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧ can refer to both psychological resistance and physical rebound/repulsion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: defiant attitude
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧: resistant reaction
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: oppositional stance
- {反発的|はんぱつてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: rebellious behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反抗的|はんこうてき}→反抗的：21089_hankouteki⟧な: rebellious; defiant — stronger, implies active disobedience
- ⟦{批判的|ひはんてき}→批判的：05665_hihanteki⟧な: critical — involves evaluating and finding fault, more intellectual than emotional
- ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧な: passive; unenthusiastic — resists by not engaging rather than pushing back
